items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: we'd cut the verve LP with Pete Fontaine on clarinet and Bob Havens on trombone. Paul Edwards, myself, Roy Zimmerman.

ctx.x: So anyway, we got that squared away. We didn't have to do too many retakes. But things like that, you'd have to do a retake. We didn't want the bus horn in there. And then about two nights later, we did volume two. And then I think, I can't remember how much later we did the verve. Maybe another month later we did the verve. But it was the same situation from 4 to 10 in the morning. We'd play 9 to 3, and then from 4 to 10 in the morning, we'd cut the verve LP with Pete Fontaine on clarinet and Bob Havens on…
I'll have to get a book out and show you the write-ups because they didn't know where the records were made. They had the year listed, but that was awesome.
